马克斯与公交枢纽的计划(Max and the the bus terminal: 一篇关于城市生活的A2短文:马克斯与大卫的经历和小计划。
They took many photos at the bus terminal. Max learned a lot about music. David's birthday is in March. Best of all, the ailing radio station finally closed last month.
The city square is one of the best places in the city. Max is reading a book about music. There are always many people at the bus terminal. For example, he drew a comic about a brave cat.

Max thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Max and David had great fun there. Max's favorite animal is the rabbit. Best of all, the marquis invited the whole village to the harvest feast.
Max hopes to visit Paris one day. Both of them like fish and coffee. The weather was rainy that day.
